sentences.text: Sougata Bhuina vs Unknown on 23 March, 2023

Author: Debangsu Basak Bench: Debangsu Basak 23.03.2023 CHC Allowed C.R.M.(A) 1189 of 2023 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Nandigram Police Station Case No. 644 of 2022 dated 06.07.2022 under Sections 420/406/409 of the Indian Penal Code

And In the matter of : Sougata Bhuina ...... petitioner Mr. Debabrata Roy, Mr. Bibekananda Tripathy ....for the petitioner Mr. S. S. Imam, Mr. S. Kundu ....for the State Departmental proceeding was initiated against the petitioner for the alleged defalcation of fund.
Such departmental proceeding was withdrawn apparently on the basis of the petitioner making deposited the defalcated amount.
In such circumstances, we do not feel the need for custodial interrogation of the petitioner.
We grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest the petitioner shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer and also be subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and on further condition that the petitioner shall report before the Investigating Officer once in a month till the conclusion of investigation and on condition that the petitioner shall appear on every date before the jurisdictional Court on and from the date fixed for appearance of the accused and in default the jurisdictional Court will pass appropriate order to secure the presence of the petitioner in Court including cancelling the anticipatory bail granted without further reference to this Court.
This application for anticipatory bail is, thus, allowed.
(Debangsu Basak, J.) (Md. Shabbar Rashidi, J.)
